description: Search the body text of Tailor Platform's public documentation and return matching pages with an excerpt. Start here for most questions, then pass an id to fetch_knowledge to read a page in full. Matching is literal and case-insensitive, so prefer the exact terms that would appear in the docs. This covers published documentation only; it cannot see a user's own application data.

limit.description: maximum number of pages to return; defaults to 10, capped at 50

query.description: words to look for in the documentation body, matched case-insensitively as a substring

source.description: restrict the search to one knowledge source; omit to search every source

name: search_knowledge
title: Search Tailor Platform documentation
